title: Qman DirectPath portable inventory verification receipt
description: Closed component receipt for one pure verification of an exact HostAuthority, signed current HostSnapshot and complete DeviceRecord set. This digest is not a signature, binary attestation, repository read proof or CAS receipt.

deviceRecords.x-qmanSetOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [deviceUid,deviceRecordHash]; duplicate deviceUid, deviceRecordHash or canonicalDigest values are rejected

x-qmanVerifierIdentityRule: inventoryVerifierAlgorithmIdentityDigest is the domain-separated component algorithm identity derived from the fixed PORTABLE_INVENTORY_VERIFIER_ALGORITHM_V2 definition and exactly seven schemaBindings in that algorithm subject: authority entities, HostSnapshot publication trace, identity V1, this receipt, the algorithm schema itself, portable entities and portable hash subjects. It is not a binary hash, build attestation or product release identity.
x-qmanInputBindingRule: trustFreshnessExpiresAt is copied from the prerequisite VerifiedTrustContext and verifiedAt is within its authenticated freshness interval. hostAuthorityCanonicalDigest is SHA-256 over the exact verified HostAuthority canonical bytes and the before/after bytes and digests are identical. hostSnapshotCanonicalDigest is SHA-256 over the exact final signed HostSnapshot canonical bytes. deviceRecords is a one-to-one complete binding of the verified records: each deviceUid equals the parsed DeviceRecord UID, each deviceRecordHash equals that record's projection hash and appears exactly once in HostSnapshot.deviceRecordDigests, and each canonicalDigest is SHA-256 over that record's exact final canonical bytes. The three descriptor fields are independently unique and descriptors are ordered by CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [deviceUid,deviceRecordHash].
x-qmanCurrentPointerRule: observedHostAuthorityResourceVersion is the committed resourceVersion in the verified before/after HostAuthority bytes; snapshotHostAuthorityResourceVersion is the same committed post-publication value signed inside HostSnapshot. This verifier requires equality and records both source names. The predecessor CAS compare operand r is consumed by publication and is not a receipt field; publication signs r+1 and atomically commits HostAuthority.resourceVersion=r+1.
x-qmanReceiptRule: Set receiptDigest to null only in the construction projection, encode exact CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes, and compute SHA-256 over ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/INVENTORY-VERIFICATION-RECEIPT/V1) || 0x00 || projection bytes. The final object carries the non-null digest. The receipt binds the exact canonical authority/snapshot/device-set inputs, verified trust context, component algorithm identity and evaluator time, but does not prove independent or linearizable repository reads, publication CAS, executable provenance or product integration.
